Theorem
[compact Type I limits are shrinking solitons] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 4.3.9\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models Let $(M,g_{ij}(t))$ be a Type I singularity model obtained as a rescaling limit of a Type I maximal solution. Suppose $M$ is compact. Then $(M,g_{ij}(t))$ must be a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton.
